meta.title: Filee — Free Drag & Drop File Converter for Windows
meta.description: Hold Ctrl, drag a file and drop it on a format. Filee converts images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and HWP/HWPX on your PC — free, open source and offline.
meta.ogAlt: Filee: a donut of formats opens at the cursor while dragging a file

title: Drag.
Drop.
Converted.
hero.lead: Hold Ctrl and drag any file. A donut of formats opens right at your cursor — drop the file on one and the converted copy appears next to the original. No upload, no windows to click through.

demo.label: Try it here
demo.hint: Drag a file onto the stage
demo.hintTouch: Drag a file with your finger
demo.close: Release in the middle to cancel
demo.empty: Your converted files show up here
demo.keyboard: With a keyboard: focus a file, press Enter, choose with the arrow keys, Enter to convert.

video.title: See it in 27 seconds
video.caption: Single images, batches of documents, HWP without Hancom Office — all with one gesture.

steps.title: Hold Ctrl and drag
steps.text: Drag files from Explorer or the desktop as you always do, with Ctrl (or any modifier you choose) held down.

steps.title: Drop on a format
steps.text: The donut opens at your cursor with the formats that make sense for those files. Hover one, let go.

steps.title: Done, next to the original
steps.text: A progress ring counts up, a check mark appears, and the new file sits right beside the source.

features.title: Everything a converter should do. Nothing it shouldn't.

items.title: A donut at your cursor
items.text: No app window in the way: formats appear where you already are. Any modifier key, mouse button, hold gesture or keyboard shortcut can open it.

items.title: Presets per file type
items.text: Quality, resizing, DPI, metadata, TIFF compression, ICO sizes, PDF merge and split, page ranges, output folder and file names.

items.title: HWP & HWPX without Hancom Office
items.text: Built-in HWPX writer keeps page setup, headers, footers, tables and text boxes when converting DOCX. HWP ↔ HWPX with rhwp.

items.title: Batch conversion
items.text: Drop 1 file or 100. Every file is converted in parallel and a failure never stops the rest.

items.title: 100% on your PC
items.text: Nothing is uploaded. Filee works offline and never sends your documents anywhere.

items.title: Four ways in
items.text: Drag gesture, Explorer right-click and Send To, a shortcut on the selected files, or the drop zone in the main window.

items.title: Soft, customizable UI
items.text: Light, dark or system theme, your accent colour, adjustable roundness and a Reduce animations switch for older PCs.

items.title: English, 한국어, 简体中文
items.text: The whole app is translated and follows your Windows language by default.

items.title: Open source, MIT
items.text: Small installer, optional engines downloaded only when you want them, automatic updates from GitHub Releases.

formats.title: 26 formats, planned routes
formats.lead: Filee finds the best path between formats automatically — for example HWPX → PDF → PNG — using the engine that does each step best.

formats.note: Office documents and Markdown use optional engines (LibreOffice, Pandoc) that Filee offers to download on first start.

hwp.title: The HWP converter that doesn't need Hancom Office
hwp.text: Hancom Office asks for approval every time another program opens a file. Filee writes HWPX itself and converts HWP ↔ HWPX with rhwp, so there is no dialog and no Hancom license needed.
points: DOCX → HWPX keeps page size, margins, headers and footers with page numbers

download.title: Ready when you are
download.text: The installer is small. Images, PDF, HWP/HWPX and DOCX → HWPX work right away; LibreOffice (~420 MB) and Pandoc (~42 MB) are offered on first start for office documents and Markdown.
